import json
def comps(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==col and (x,y) not in seen: st.append((x,y))
                out.append((col,cells))
    return out

def slide(g, tiebreak='maxrow'):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    shapes=comps(g)
    # order: maxcol desc
    shapes.sort(key=lambda s:(max(c for _,c in s[1]), max(r for r,_ in s[1]) if tiebreak=='maxrow' else -min(r for r,_ in s[1])), reverse=True)
    for col,cells in shapes:
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=0
        mc=max(c for _,c in cells)
        while mc<w-1:
            nc=mc+1
            if any(g[r][c+1] for r,c in cells): break
            for r,c in cells: g[r][c+1]=col
            for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=0
            mc=nc
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=col
    return g
# careful: incremental shifting — recheck logic; do simpler: compute shift then place
def slide2(g, tiebreak='maxrow'):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); shapes=comps(g)
    shapes.sort(key=lambda s:(max(c for _,c in s[1]), max(r for r,_ in s[1]) if tiebreak=='maxrow' else -min(r for r,_ in s[1])), reverse=True)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for col,cells in shapes:
        mc=max(c for _,c in cells)
        s=0
        while mc+s<w-1 and all(out[r][c+s+1]==0 for r,c in cells): s+=1
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+s]=col
    return out
